name: Arandu Investimentos S.A.
summary: Arandu Investimentos S.A. maintains a digital platform that serves to connect diverse professionals, private individuals, and corporate entities across Brazil. In addition to this digital connectivity, the company also oversees investment funds concentrated on real estate and equity assets. The firm transitioned to its current name, Arandu Investimentos S.A., in November 2025, having previously been identified as REAG Investimentos S.A. Its principal office is situated in São Paulo, Brazil.
